comment: Config for tools/m68k2c.py (see its docstring). roots: routines translated with everything they call that is not hand-ported; the task roots are the code after each task descriptor's tag (docs/NOTES.md). yield: Yield ($400). exits: $3B8 (wait for the next frame: emulated time has to pass), $4BF8 (reset the stack, re-enter the frame loop), $4A06 (restart), $4CB4 (hang: no free task slot). defer: Kgam, the gameplay task (about 900 routines), left to its own step. Addresses only.
